pkgmetadata.longdescription: AyuGram is a Telegram Desktop fork with Ghost mode, message history, filters and extra customization. Built from source; the ebuild is based on ::gentoo net-im/telegram-desktop.

use.flag: Use the app-text/enchant spell-checking backend instead of app-text/hunspell
Use builtin patched copy of open-sans fonts (overrides fontconfig)
Render text through x11-libs/pango instead of the private Qt API (Recommended)
